mapper.select: SELECT IF(parent.name = '中国', s.dest_id, parent.id) as refid, IF(parent.name = '中国', child.name, parent.name) as name, count(*) total FROM strategy s JOIN destination child ON child.id = s.dest_id JOIN destination parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE s.state = 1 AND s.isabroad = 0 GROUP BY s.dest_id, s.dest_name ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT IFNULL(parent.id, s.dest_id) as refid, IFNULL(parent.name, child.name) as name, count(*) total FROM strategy s JOIN destination child ON child.id = s.dest_id LEFT JOIN destination parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE s.state = 1 AND s.isabroad = 1 GROUP BY s.dest_id, s.dest_name ORDER BY total DESC
SELECT theme_id as refid, theme_name as name, count(*) total FROM strategy WHERE state = 1 GROUP BY theme_id, theme_name ORDER BY total DESC
